_comment: Genesis overlay for the stablenet account-Extra bitmap cases (authorized-extra-bit-synced / blacklisted-extra-bit-synced / dual-status-extra / extra-balance-preserved). It adds three alloc accounts whose Extra bits seed AccountManager status at genesis-init: bit 62 (0x4000000000000000) = authorized, bit 63 (0x8000000000000000) = blacklisted, both = 0xc000000000000000. go-stablenet applies these via statedb.SetExtra during genesis, and the AccountManager system contract (0x…B00003) reads them back through isAuthorized/isBlacklisted. Deep-merged into the built stablenet genesis; declares the account-extra capability so the gated cases run. NOTE: do NOT also seed config.anzeon.systemContracts.govCouncil.params here — the base template's govCouncil.params is a flat string-map, so merging authorized/blacklisted ARRAYS into it makes genesis init fail (cannot unmarshal array into a string field). The alloc Extra bits alone drive the AccountManager status the cases assert.
